caption: The drawing depicts a single, large cross positioned upright in the center of the composition. The cross is composed of intersecting rectangular bars with decorative patterns consisting of repeating quatrefoil shapes inside each section of the cross. At the top and ends of the horizontal arm, as well as the top of the vertical arm, there are circular shapes; the top circle is capped with a dome-like ornament. At the base of the cross, additional decorative elements are present, including symmetrical spiral designs on each side, connected to a rectangular frame. The cross appears to stand on a plinth or base, indicated by angled lines and parallel hatched lines suggesting depth and shadow beneath. The drawing is rendered in pencil or charcoal on off-white or beige paper, and is enclosed within a faint rectangular border. There is no text or additional objects within the composition.
title: Cross
